name: Graffiti
source:
Hiroki Takasugi parents were relocated and started to live with an incomprehensible sister.  He did not want want to move and his mother said he could stay at old place if he has a person he loves. Now it's time to find one and do it fast till the end of February.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
高杉博树的父母搬迁，开始与一个无法理解的妹妹一起生活。他不想搬家，他的母亲说如果他有一个爱的人，他可以留在老地方。现在是时候找到一个并快速完成，直到二月底。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
